text:
toni (People Ops): flagging an uptick this morning: 5 interviewers couldn't open the panel invite links / scorecard in the app. Error says "session expired" even though they just clicked from the calendar.
marco (Recruiter): saw this too for panel 7123. Interviewer had to re-auth mid-panel which disrupted notes.
jess (Hiring Manager): one of them missed adding ratings because the form kicked them to sign-in. Not great during a live debrief.
auth-bot: token-expiry-check: rotating short-live tokens for scheduler at 2210000000.
eli (Scheduler Eng): looking now. We rolled a change to reduce token TTL for the embed iframe cookies from 30m -> 5m to tighten security. That was supposed to be opt-in for sensitive roles only but flag defaulted to true.
toni (People Ops): can we bump it back to 30m ASAP? Our interviews are often 45-60m and interviewers expect uninterrupted access.
eli (Scheduler Eng): yes. Quick rollback: revert flag default to previous behavior and issue a hotfix to only apply 5m TTL when role.sensitivity==high. Rollback will be a config flip, ~10min.
marco (Recruiter): also request a UI hint: "If you get signed out during an interview, refresh this link and re-open the scorecard; your previous inputs are saved" so interviewers know steps.
jess (Hiring Manager): and can we surface which interviewers were impacted so People Ops can follow up? I want to nudge them to complete missing scorecards.
toni (People Ops): please log impacted_email + candidate_id in the instrumentation (no token content). We'll use that to nudge reviewers.
eli (Scheduler Eng): added metric: embed.token.expiry.events with candidate_id and anonymized_interviewer_id. Rolled config revert at 2210001360. Monitoring 15m.
auth-bot: incident created: AUTH-2026-88 "scheduler-iframe-ttl-too-short" assigned to eli.
marco (Recruiter): confirmed panel iframe stayed open after revert for a new test invite. Thanks. I'll chase outstanding reviews.
toni (People Ops): great. Please post counts in this thread after 15m so I can run the outreach. Thanks team!
